  <!-- ==================== THE LEDGER ==================== -->
  <section class="ledger" aria-labelledby="ledger-title">
    <div class="sec-head">
      <h2 class="sec-title" id="ledger-title" data-scramble>The Ledger</h2>
      <p class="sec-meta">Twenty-four entries — No. 01 leads above</p>
    </div>

    <div class="ledger-grid">

      <div class="card-wrap" data-io>
        <article class="bill-card" id="no-02">
          <div class="card-top"><span class="no">No. 02</span><span>Filed: Bakers</span></div>
          <h3 class="bill-name">The Baker of Bream Street</h3>
          <div class="verse">
            <span class="vline" style="--i:0"><span>Old Bill the baker, up at three,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:1"><span>Kneaded, shaped, with great ceremony;</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:2"><span>From dawn he’d bake and sell</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:3"><span>Till the market’s opening bell,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:4"><span>Then charge double for the wee.</span></span>
          </div>
          <p class="marg"><span class="star">*</span> The “wee” are the small ones. The wee were not consulted.</p>
          <div class="seal" aria-hidden="true">B</div>
        </article>
      </div>

      <div class="card-wrap" data-io>
        <article class="bill-card" id="no-03">
          <div class="card-top"><span class="no">No. 03</span><span>Filed: Boatmen</span></div>
          <h3 class="bill-name">The Boatman of Bracken Bay</h3>
          <div class="verse">
            <span class="vline" style="--i:0"><span>Old Bill the boatman, on the tide,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:1"><span>Would row his passengers with pride;</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:2"><span>When a wave did sway</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:3"><span>His little gray skiff away,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:4"><span>He’d call out: “All steady — glide!”</span></span>
          </div>
          <figure class="card-art kb">
            <div class="frame"><img src="https://picsum.photos/seed/bill-boatman-tide/620/330" alt="The boatman offshore at Bracken Bay, engraving" loading="lazy"></div>
            <figcaption>The subject, offshore (Bracken Bay)</figcaption>
          </figure>
          <p class="marg"><span class="star">*</span> The skiff was returned the next week. The passengers, regrettably, declined it.</p>
          <div class="seal" aria-hidden="true">B</div>
        </article>
      </div>

      <div class="card-wrap" data-io>
        <article class="bill-card" id="no-04">
          <div class="card-top"><span class="no">No. 04</span><span>Filed: Butlers</span></div>
          <h3 class="bill-name">The Butler</h3>
          <div class="verse">
            <span class="vline" style="--i:0"><span>A butler named Bill, starched to shine,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:1"><span>Polished every spoon in a line.</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:2"><span>When a guest once asked why</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:3"><span>He bowed so deep and shy,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:4"><span>He replied: “Sir — I polish time.”</span></span>
          </div>
          <p class="marg"><span class="star">*</span> Time has since asked for a second butler. The household refused.</p>
          <div class="seal" aria-hidden="true">B</div>
        </article>
      </div>

      <div class="card-wrap" data-io>
        <article class="bill-card" id="no-05">
          <div class="card-top"><span class="no">No. 05</span><span>Filed: Binders</span></div>
          <h3 class="bill-name">The Bookbinder</h3>
          <div class="verse">
            <span class="vline" style="--i:0"><span>Young Bill the bookbinder — thread and twine —</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:1"><span>Bound each cover, neat, and fine;</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:2"><span>He stitched, till one night,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:3"><span>By a library’s light,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:4"><span>He woke, book-bound, spine by spine.</span></span>
          </div>
          <p class="marg"><span class="star">*</span> The novel in question: <em>Wuthering Heights</em>. All of it, including the margins.</p>
          <div class="seal" aria-hidden="true">B</div>
        </article>
      </div>

      <div class="card-wrap" data-io>
        <article class="bill-card" id="no-06">
          <div class="card-top"><span class="no">No. 06</span><span>Filed: Brokers</span></div>
          <h3 class="bill-name">The Broker</h3>
          <div class="verse">
            <span class="vline" style="--i:0"><span>The broker, a fidgety Bill,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:1"><span>Called every crash “an excellent fill”;</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:2"><span>He shouted: “Buy! Buy!”</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:3"><span>As the red candles fly,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:4"><span>Then retired early to the hill.</span></span>
          </div>
          <p class="marg"><span class="star">*</span> The hill is now a private road. The toll is forty percent.</p>
          <div class="seal" aria-hidden="true">B</div>
        </article>
      </div>

      <div class="card-wrap" data-io>
        <article class="bill-card" id="no-07">
          <div class="card-top"><span class="no">No. 07</span><span>Filed: Bellmen</span></div>
          <h3 class="bill-name">The Bellman</h3>
          <div class="verse">
            <span class="vline" style="--i:0"><span>The bellman Bill, who rang the three,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:1"><span>Was heard as far as the sea;</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:2"><span>He’d bellow “UP!” from the tower—</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:3"><span>The whole town would lower</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:4"><span>Its blankets, and cry: “Make us free!”</span></span>
          </div>
          <p class="marg"><span class="star">*</span> The town voted for “up” at nine. Bill, after consultation, agreed.</p>
          <div class="seal" aria-hidden="true">B</div>
        </article>
      </div>

      <div class="card-wrap" data-io>
        <article class="bill-card" id="no-08">
          <div class="card-top"><span class="no">No. 08</span><span>Filed: Blacksmiths</span></div>
          <h3 class="bill-name">The Blacksmith</h3>
          <div class="verse">
            <span class="vline" style="--i:0"><span>The blacksmith Bill, hammer in hand,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:1"><span>Kept a business plan grand:</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:2"><span>Nails at the morn,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:3"><span>Chains by the lawn,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:4"><span>Horseshoes — by sundown, as planned.</span></span>
          </div>
          <figure class="card-art kb">
            <div class="frame"><img src="https://picsum.photos/seed/bill-blacksmith-forge/620/330" alt="A forge at dawn, engraving" loading="lazy"></div>
            <figcaption>The forge, lit at dawn</figcaption>
          </figure>
          <p class="marg"><span class="star">*</span> The lawn has been replaced by a chain. Neighbors report no regrets.</p>
          <div class="seal" aria-hidden="true">B</div>
        </article>
      </div>

      <div class="card-wrap" data-io>
        <article class="bill-card" id="no-09">
          <div class="card-top"><span class="no">No. 09</span><span>Filed: Beekeepers</span></div>
          <h3 class="bill-name">The Beekeeper</h3>
          <div class="verse">
            <span class="vline" style="--i:0"><span>The beekeeper, a timid Bill,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:1"><span>Addressed the swarm with a skill:</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:2"><span>“Excuse the intrusion —</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:3"><span>I mean no confusion.”</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:4"><span>The bees gave him honey, still.</span></span>
          </div>
          <figure class="card-art kb">
            <div class="frame"><img src="https://picsum.photos/seed/bill-bees-hive/620/330" alt="A hive in a hedgerow, engraving" loading="lazy"></div>
            <figcaption>The hive, addressed (No. 09)</figcaption>
          </figure>
          <p class="marg"><span class="star">*</span> The swarm’s reply, transcribed: “Hm.”</p>
          <div class="seal" aria-hidden="true">B</div>
        </article>
      </div>

      <div class="card-wrap" data-io>
        <article class="bill-card" id="no-10">
          <div class="card-top"><span class="no">No. 10</span><span>Filed: Botanists</span></div>
          <h3 class="bill-name">The Botanist</h3>
          <div class="verse">
            <span class="vline" style="--i:0"><span>The botanist, who ran the show,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:1"><span>Tutted at each vine that would grow.</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:2"><span>“Up with the trellis!”</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:3"><span>He’d bellow at his parsley;</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:4"><span>The garden filed a complaint, you know.</span></span>
          </div>
          <p class="marg"><span class="star">*</span> The complaint was a tomato. It has not been heard.</p>
          <div class="seal" aria-hidden="true">B</div>
        </article>
      </div>

      <div class="card-wrap" data-io>
        <article class="bill-card" id="no-11">
          <div class="card-top"><span class="no">No. 11</span><span>Filed: Bridges</span></div>
          <h3 class="bill-name">The Bridge-Builder</h3>
          <div class="verse">
            <span class="vline" style="--i:0"><span>The bridge-builder, up at noon,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:1"><span>Hummed a waltz in a minor tune;</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:2"><span>When a stone would not hold,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:3"><span>He’d tap it: “There — now we’re gold.”</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:4"><span>And the footbridge was done, before June.</span></span>
          </div>
          <p class="marg"><span class="star">*</span> The river objects that it was never asked. The river is usually like that.</p>
          <div class="seal" aria-hidden="true">B</div>
        </article>
      </div>

      <div class="card-wrap" data-io>
        <article class="bill-card" id="no-12">
          <div class="card-top"><span class="no">No. 12</span><span>Filed: Brewers</span></div>
          <h3 class="bill-name">The Brewer</h3>
          <div class="verse">
            <span class="vline" style="--i:0"><span>The brewer Bill, whose barley grew</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:1"><span>In his cellar, beside the brew;</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:2"><span>He tapped it and poured —</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:3"><span>And the whole town was in accord:</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:4"><span>“That’s the stoutest of any I knew.”</span></span>
          </div>
          <p class="marg"><span class="star">*</span> The barley grew best on limericks. This is a known effect.</p>
          <div class="seal" aria-hidden="true">B</div>
        </article>
      </div>

      <div class="card-wrap" data-io>
        <article class="bill-card" id="no-13">
          <div class="card-top"><span class="no">No. 13</span><span>Filed: Reader</span></div>
          <h3 class="bill-name">The Bibliophile</h3>
          <div class="verse">
            <span class="vline" style="--i:0"><span>The bibliophile, a Bill,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:1"><span>Whose shelves leaned but would not spill;</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:2"><span>He stacked, and he stacked,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:3"><span>Till the flat’s walls went black,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:4"><span>Then bought ten more — that’s a thrill.</span></span>
          </div>
          <p class="marg"><span class="star">*</span> The books, as a group, have asked for more room. It has not been given.</p>
          <div class="seal" aria-hidden="true">B</div>
        </article>
      </div>

      <div class="card-wrap" data-io>
        <aside class="usage" id="usage-note">
          <h3>A Note on Usage</h3>
          <p>A bill may be a young salmon, a document requesting payment, or a man who has, in this edition, been rhymed. The Gazette treats all three with equal suspicion and no particular haste.</p>
          <p class="sig">— The Editor, at the desk, 3 a.m.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>

      <div class="card-wrap" data-io>
        <article class="bill-card" id="no-14">
          <div class="card-top"><span class="no">No. 14</span><span>Filed: Heavy Machinery</span></div>
          <h3 class="bill-name">The Bulldozer Driver</h3>
          <div class="verse">
            <span class="vline" style="--i:0"><span>The bulldozer driver, Bill, by two,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:1"><span>Would level the hills and the view.</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:2"><span>When he spotted a flower,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:3"><span>He’d halt, and give it a shower;</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:4"><span>The flower sued — and won, you know.</span></span>
          </div>
          <p class="marg"><span class="star">*</span> The court ordered one daffodil per acre. Bill complied. The daffodils did not.</p>
          <div class="seal" aria-hidden="true">B</div>
        </article>
      </div>

      <div class="card-wrap" data-io>
        <article class="bill-card" id="no-15">
          <div class="card-top"><span class="no">No. 15</span><span>Filed: Conductors</span></div>
          <h3 class="bill-name">The Bus Conductor</h3>
          <div class="verse">
            <span class="vline" style="--i:0"><span>The bus conductor, a spare Bill,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:1"><span>Called each stop with a great thrill;</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:2"><span>When the route hit a flood,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:3"><span>He said: “You may swim — I’ll</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:4"><span>Row to the next stop on the hill.”</span></span>
          </div>
          <p class="marg"><span class="star">*</span> The flood was, on inspection, a canal. Bill rows regardless.</p>
          <div class="seal" aria-hidden="true">B</div>
        </article>
      </div>

      <div class="card-wrap" data-io>
        <article class="bill-card" id="no-16">
          <div class="card-top"><span class="no">No. 16</span><span>Filed: Thieves (Amateur)</span></div>
          <h3 class="bill-name">The Gentle Burglar</h3>
          <div class="verse">
            <span class="vline" style="--i:0"><span>The burglar Bill, at the break of day,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:1"><span>Knocked and said: “I must steal away —</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:2"><span>Two spoons, and a candle.”</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:3"><span>The owner: “Take the handle,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:4"><span>The sugar. The cat will say.”</span></span>
          </div>
          <p class="marg"><span class="star">*</span> The cat voted no. Bill left the spoons and the tea.</p>
          <div class="seal" aria-hidden="true">B</div>
        </article>
      </div>

      <div class="card-wrap" data-io>
        <article class="bill-card" id="no-17">
          <div class="card-top"><span class="no">No. 17</span><span>Filed: Chess</span></div>
          <h3 class="bill-name">The Chess Master</h3>
          <div class="verse">
            <span class="vline" style="--i:0"><span>The chess master, Bill, by the dawn,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:1"><span>Moved his knight and his pawn;</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:2"><span>When his rival, her best,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:3"><span>Tapped the queen and said: “Rest.</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:4"><span>I resign — I’d rather yawn.”</span></span>
          </div>
          <p class="marg"><span class="star">*</span> The game lasted four moves. The yawn was, in hindsight, the true checkmate.</p>
          <div class="seal" aria-hidden="true">B</div>
        </article>
      </div>

      <div class="card-wrap" data-io>
        <article class="bill-card" id="no-18">
          <div class="card-top"><span class="no">No. 18</span><span>Filed: Horology</span></div>
          <h3 class="bill-name">The Clockmaker</h3>
          <div class="verse">
            <span class="vline" style="--i:0"><span>The clockmaker, whose life was a clock,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:1"><span>Told the time to the tock.</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:2"><span>When the chime was late,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:3"><span>He’d climb up, in his coat,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:4"><span>And knock at the sky with a rock.</span></span>
          </div>
          <p class="marg"><span class="star">*</span> The sky has, we are told, been punctual since.</p>
          <div class="seal" aria-hidden="true">B</div>
        </article>
      </div>

      <div class="card-wrap" data-io>
        <article class="bill-card" id="no-19">
          <div class="card-top"><span class="no">No. 19</span><span>Filed: Music</span></div>
          <h3 class="bill-name">The Orchestra Conductor</h3>
          <div class="verse">
            <span class="vline" style="--i:0"><span>The orchestra’s Bill, spare and tall,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:1"><span>Conducted with a very small</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:2"><span>Bow; when a cello</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:3"><span>Once ignored his mellow,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:4"><span>He turned, and conducted the hall.</span></span>
          </div>
          <p class="marg"><span class="star">*</span> The hall was, according to witnesses, “a bit loud but honest.”</p>
          <div class="seal" aria-hidden="true">B</div>
        </article>
      </div>

      <div class="card-wrap" data-io>
        <article class="bill-card" id="no-20">
          <div class="card-top"><span class="no">No. 20</span><span>Filed: Maps</span></div>
          <h3 class="bill-name">The Cartographer</h3>
          <div class="verse">
            <span class="vline" style="--i:0"><span>The cartographer, who’d draw the map</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:1"><span>Of the world — but there was a gap:</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:2"><span>His own lane was missing,</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:3"><span>And the ink was still hissing.</span></span>
            <span class="vline" style="--i:4"><span>He said: “That’s the sea,” and took a nap.</span></span>
          </div>
          <p class="marg"><span class="star">*</span> Surveyors have since marked the lane. Bill has since re-marked the sea.</p>
          <div class="seal" aria-hidden="true">B</div>
        </article>
      </div>

      <div class="card-wrap" data-io>
        <article class="bill-card" id="no-21">
          <div class="card-top"><span class="no">No. 21</span><span>Filed: Pools</span></div>

Note: "FILED: HEAVY MACHINERY. The court ordered one daffodil per acre. Bill complied. The daffodils did not."

Note: "FILED: THIEVES (AMATEUR). The cat voted no. Bill left the spoons and the tea."

Note: "FILED: CHESS. The game lasted four moves. The yawn, in hindsight, was the true checkmate."

Let me write the JS scramble function:

function scramble(el){
 const final = el.dataset.text || el.textContent;
 el.dataset.text = final;
 const chars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ§&*#—";
 let frame = 0;
 const total = 34;
 const tick = () => {
   frame++;
   const done = Math.floor((frame/total)*final.length);
   let out = final.slice(0, done);
   for(let i=done;i<final.length;i++){
     out += final[i]===" " ? " " : chars[Math.floor(Math.random()*chars.length)];
   }
   el.textContent = out;
   if(frame<total) requestAnimationFrame(tick); else el.textContent = final;
 };
 tick();
}

function typeVerse(container, lines){
 container.innerHTML="";
 let li=0;
 const nextLine = () => {
   if(li>=lines.length) return;
   const outer=document.createElement('span'); outer.className='vline';
   const inner=document.createElement('span'); inner.style.setProperty('--i',0);
   outer.appendChild(inner); container.appendChild(outer);
   // Force reveal:
   requestAnimationFrame(()=> inner.classList.add('shown'));
   const text = lines[li]; let ci=0;
   const t = setInterval(()=>{
     inner.textContent = text.slice(0, ++ci);
     if(ci>=text.length){clearInterval(t); li++; setTimeout(nextLine, 120);}
   }, 22);
 };
 nextLine();
}

02:
Old Bill the baker, up at three,
Kneaded, shaped, with great ceremony;
From dawn he'd bake and sell
Till the market's opening bell,
Then charge double for the wee.

03:
Old Bill the boatman, on the tide,
Would row his passengers with pride;
When a wave did sway
His little gray skiff away,
He'd call out: "All steady — glide!"

04:
A butler named Bill, starched to shine,
Polished every spoon in a line.
When a guest once asked why
He bowed so deep and shy,
He replied: "Sir — I polish time."

05:
Young Bill the bookbinder — thread and twine —
Bound each cover, neat, and fine;
He stitched, till one night,
By a library's light,
He woke, book-bound, spine by spine.

06:
The broker, a fidgety Bill,
Called every crash "an excellent fill";
He shouted: "Buy! Buy!"
As the red candles fly,
Then retired early to the hill.

07:
The bellman Bill, who rang the three,
Was heard as far as the sea;
He'd bellow "UP!" from the tower—
The whole town would lower
Its blankets, and cry: "Make us free!"

08:
The blacksmith Bill, hammer in hand,
Kept a business plan grand:
Nails at the morn,
Chains by the lawn,
Horseshoes — by sundown, as planned.

09:
The beekeeper, a timid Bill,
Addressed the swarm with a skill:
"Excuse the intrusion —
I mean no confusion."
The bees gave him honey, still.

10:
The botanist, who ran the show,
Tutted at each vine that would grow.
"Up with the trellis!"
He'd bellow at his parsley;
The garden filed a complaint, you know.

11:
The bridge-builder, up at noon,
Hummed a waltz in a minor tune;
When a stone would not hold,
He'd tap it: "There — now we're gold."
And the footbridge was done, before June.

12:
The brewer Bill, whose barley grew
In his cellar, beside the brew;
He tapped it and poured —
And the whole town was in accord:
"That's the stoutest of any I knew."

13:
The bibliophile, a Bill,
Whose shelves leaned but would not spill;
He stacked, and he stacked,
Till the flat's walls went black,
Then bought ten more — that's a thrill.

14:
The bulldozer driver, Bill, by two,
Would level the hills and the view.
When he spotted a flower,
He'd halt, and give it a shower;
The flower sued — and won, you know.

15:
The bus conductor, a spare Bill,
Called each stop with a great thrill;
When the route hit a flood,
He said: "You may swim — I'll
Row to the next stop on the hill."

16:
The burglar Bill, at the break of day,
Knocked and said: "I must steal away —
Two spoons, and a candle."
The owner: "Take the handle,
The sugar. The cat will say."

17:
The chess master, Bill, by the dawn,
Moved his knight and his pawn;
When his rival, her best,
Tapped the queen and said: "Rest.
I resign — I'd rather yawn."

18:
The clockmaker, whose life was a clock,
Told the time to the tock.
When the chime was late,
He'd climb up, in his coat,
And knock at the sky with a rock.

19:
The orchestra's Bill, spare and tall,
Conducted with a very small
Bow; when a cello
Once ignored his mellow,
He turned, and conducted the hall.

20:
The cartographer, who'd draw the map
Of the world — but there was a gap:
His own lane was missing,
And the ink was still hissing.
He said: "That's the sea," and took a nap.

21:
The diver Bill, who ran the pool,
Was the calmest man of the school;
When a pupil went round and round,
He'd surface, with a pound
Of coins: "The fee — ma'am, stay cool."

22:
The dentist Bill, with a steady will,
Polished, pried, and worked the drill;
He'd say: "Open wide —"
And the patient would hide
Behind gauze, and whisper: "I'll."

23:
The economist Bill, who'd chart the bill
Of the nation — steady, and still;
When a price rose, once,
He'd nod: "That's the course —
The market billing its fill."

24:
Bill and Jurgen, the odd pair,
Kept a bar, and argued, in the air;
But at closing time,
They'd clink glasses in a chime,
And the bill, half and half, they'd declare.

25:
Of the twenty-five Bills, one by one,
I have set down this ledger — it's begun;
But if you know a Bill
Who is no Bill at all,
This page, friend, is not yet done.

function shuffle(){
  const notes=[...grid.children];
  const first=notes.map(n=>n.getBoundingClientRect());
  // Fisher-Yates
  for(let i=notes.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[grid.children[i],grid.children[j]]=[grid.children[j],grid.children[i]];}
  notes.forEach((n,i)=>{
    const last=n.getBoundingClientRect();
    const dx=first[i].left-last.left, dy=first[i].top-last.top;
    n.style.transition='none';
    n.style.transform=`translate(${dx}px,${dy}px)`;
    requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>{
      n.style.transition='transform .6s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.26,1)';
      n.style.transform='';
      n.style.setProperty('--tilt', randTilt());
    }));
  });
  setTimeout(()=>notes.forEach(n=>n.style.transition=''),700);
}
```

function shuffle(){

  const t=tilted();

  k.style.transform=`rotate(${t})`;
  k.style.setProperty('--tilt',t);

  <article class="note" data-id="1" tabindex="0" aria-label="Limerick 1, The Kildare Ledger. Activate to bounce it.">
    <div class="note-inner">
      <header class="note-head"><span class="serial">Nº 001</span><svg class="seal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#rosette"/></svg><span class="issue">KILDARE</span></header>
      <h3>The Kildare Ledger</h3>
      <div class="verse">
        <p data-r="A">There was a young Bill from Kildare</p>
        <p data-r="A">Who kept every receipt that was there —</p>
        <p data-r="B">For socks, for his lunch,</p>
        <p data-r="B">For the post, and such:</p>
        <p data-r="A" class="last">Five thousand bills in a chair.</p>
      </div>
      <footer class="micro">Not legal tender · aabba · handle with a light hand</footer>
    </div>
    <span class="note-num" aria-hidden="true">01</span>
  </article>

  <article class="note" data-id="2" tabindex="0" aria-label="Limerick 2, The Quay Economist. Activate to bounce it.">
    <div class="note-inner">
      <header class="note-head"><span class="serial">Nº 002</span><svg class="seal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#rosette"/></svg><span class="issue">THE QUAY</span></header>
      <h3>The Quay Economist</h3>
      <div class="verse">
        <p data-r="A">An economist, Bill, from the quay</p>
        <p data-r="A">Graphed out the true price of the day;</p>
        <p data-r="B">He mislaid the whole chart,</p>
        <p data-r="B">And had to restart:</p>
        <p data-r="A" class="last">He was charting the pay.</p>
      </div>
      <footer class="micro">Not legal tender · aabba · bounce before folding</footer>
    </div>
    <span class="note-num" aria-hidden="true">02</span>
  </article>

  <article class="note" data-id="3" tabindex="0" aria-label="Limerick 3, A Note From Jurgen. Activate to bounce it.">
    <div class="note-inner">
      <header class="note-head"><span class="serial">Nº 003</span><svg class="seal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#rosette"/></svg><span class="issue">THE FIRM</span></header>
      <h3>A Note From Jurgen</h3>
      <div class="verse">
        <p data-r="A">The economist, Jurgen, one day</p>
        <p data-r="A">Sent a bill to the firm, and they'd pay;</p>
        <p data-r="B">Bill, with a grin,</p>
        <p data-r="B">Said, "My wage's coming in!" —</p>
        <p data-r="A" class="last">But it never was paid.</p>
      </div>
      <footer class="micro">Not legal tender · aabba · this note bounces</footer>
    </div>
    <span class="note-num" aria-hidden="true">03</span>
  </article>

  <article class="note" data-id="4" tabindex="0" aria-label="Limerick 4, The Bally Billigator. Activate to bounce it.">
    <div class="note-inner">
      <header class="note-head"><span class="serial">Nº 004</span><svg class="seal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#rosette"/></svg><span class="issue">BALLY</span></header>
      <h3>The Bally Billigator</h3>
      <div class="verse">
        <p data-r="A">There was a young Bill from Bally</p>
        <p data-r="A">Who'd tamed a billigator daily —</p>
        <p data-r="B">The neighbors were scared;</p>
        <p data-r="B">He said, "Not a word:</p>
        <p data-r="A" class="last">He's a good boy — he barks gaily."</p>
      </div>
      <footer class="micro">Not legal tender · aabba · handle with a light hand</footer>
    </div>
    <span class="note-num" aria-hidden="true">04</span>
  </article>

  <article class="note" data-id="5" tabindex="0" aria-label="Limerick 5, Triple Fare. Activate to bounce it.">
    <div class="note-inner">
      <header class="note-head"><span class="serial">Nº 005</span><svg class="seal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#rosette"/></svg><span class="issue">THE FAIR</span></header>
      <h3>Triple Fare</h3>
      <div class="verse">
        <p data-r="A">There was a young Bill from the fair</p>
        <p data-r="A">Whose accountant sent triple the fare;</p>
        <p data-r="B">"Double! Triple!" cried Bill —</p>
        <p data-r="B">The letter said, "Still,</p>
        <p data-r="A" class="last">You must pay it, by the square."</p>
      </div>
      <footer class="micro">Not legal tender · aabba · bounce before folding</footer>
    </div>
    <span class="note-num" aria-hidden="true">05</span>
  </article>

  <article class="note" data-id="6" tabindex="0" aria-label="Limerick 6, A Fine Call. Activate to bounce it.">
    <div class="note-inner">
      <header class="note-head"><span class="serial">Nº 006</span><svg class="seal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#rosette"/></svg><span class="issue">THE HALL</span></header>
      <h3>A Fine Call</h3>
      <div class="verse">
        <p data-r="A">There was a young Bill from the hall</p>
        <p data-r="A">Who could pot the last brown of them all;</p>
        <p data-r="B">The cue, on its way,</p>
        <p data-r="B">Knocked a teacup astray</p>
        <p data-r="A" class="last">Into Bill — a fine call.</p>
      </div>
      <footer class="micro">Not legal tender · aabba · this note bounces</footer>
    </div>
    <span class="note-num" aria-hidden="true">06</span>
  </article>

  <article class="note" data-id="7" tabindex="0" aria-label="Limerick 7, The Mill Bell. Activate to bounce it.">
    <div class="note-inner">
      <header class="note-head"><span class="serial">Nº 007</span><svg class="seal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#rosette"/></svg><span class="issue">THE MILL</span></header>
      <h3>The Mill Bell</h3>
      <div class="verse">
        <p data-r="A">There was a young Bill from the mill</p>
        <p data-r="A">Who rang the bell with great skill;</p>
        <p data-r="B">He rang one, he rang two,</p>
        <p data-r="B">He rang three — and he'd do</p>
        <p data-r="A" class="last">Another, but then it was still.</p>
      </div>
      <footer class="micro">Not legal tender · aabba · handle with a light hand</footer>
    </div>
    <span class="note-num" aria-hidden="true">07</span>
  </article>

  <article class="note" data-id="8" tabindex="0" aria-label="Limerick 8, Supper at the Den. Activate to bounce it.">
    <div class="note-inner">
      <header class="note-head"><span class="serial">Nº 008</span><svg class="seal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#rosette"/></svg><span class="issue">THE DEN</span></header>
      <h3>Supper at the Den</h3>
      <div class="verse">
        <p data-r="A">There was a young Bill from the den</p>
        <p data-r="A">Whose wife, Jill, named their cat, Ben;</p>
        <p data-r="B">The two would brawl</p>
        <p data-r="B">At the first supper call —</p>
        <p data-r="A" class="last">And it always went to the hen.</p>
      </div>
      <footer class="micro">Not legal tender · aabba · bounce before folding</footer>
    </div>
    <span class="note-num" aria-hidden="true">08</span>
  </article>

  <article class="note" data-id="9" tabindex="0" aria-label="Limerick 9, The Lost Letter. Activate to bounce it.">
    <div class="note-inner">
      <header class="note-head"><span class="serial">Nº 009</span><svg class="seal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#rosette"/></svg><span class="issue">THE SHORE</span></header>
      <h3>The Lost Letter</h3>
      <div class="verse">
        <p data-r="A">There was a young Bill from the shore</p>
        <p data-r="A">Who worked in the post, at the door;</p>
        <p data-r="B">He found one lost letter —</p>
        <p data-r="B">His own! It said, "Better</p>
        <p data-r="A" class="last">Pay the rent" — and he'd be sore.</p>
      </div>
      <footer class="micro">Not legal tender · aabba · this note bounces</footer>
    </div>
    <span class="note-num" aria-hidden="true">09</span>
  </article>

  <article class="note" data-id="10" tabindex="0" aria-label="Limerick 10, The Fourth Floor. Activate to bounce it.">
    <div class="note-inner">
      <header class="note-head"><span class="serial">Nº 010</span><svg class="seal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#rosette"/></svg><span class="issue">THE FAIR</span></header>
      <h3>The Fourth Floor</h3>
      <div class="verse">
        <p data-r="A">There was a young Bill from the fair</p>
        <p data-r="A">Who was seven feet tall to the hair;</p>
        <p data-r="B">He'd duck at each door</p>
        <p data-r="B">On the fourth floor of the store —</p>
        <p data-r="A" class="last">And the frame kept his hair square.</p>
      </div>
      <footer class="micro">Not legal tender · aabba · handle with a light hand</footer>
    </div>
    <span class="note-num" aria-hidden="true">10</span>
  </article>

  <article class="note" data-id="11" tabindex="0" aria-label="Limerick 11, The Unpaid Brewer. Activate to bounce it.">
    <div class="note-inner">
      <header class="note-head"><span class="serial">Nº 011</span><svg class="seal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#rosette"/></svg><span class="issue">THE QUAY</span></header>
      <h3>The Unpaid Brewer</h3>
      <div class="verse">
        <p data-r="A">There was a young Bill from the quay</p>
        <p data-r="A">Who brewed a stout beer every day;</p>
        <p data-r="B">The whole town would drink</p>
        <p data-r="B">Till the barrels all sank,</p>
        <p data-r="A" class="last">And Bill was never paid.</p>
      </div>
      <footer class="micro">Not legal tender · aabba · bounce before folding</footer>
    </div>
    <span class="note-num" aria-hidden="true">11</span>
  </article>

  <article class="note" data-id="12" tabindex="0" aria-label="Limerick 12, The Gavel. Activate to bounce it.">
    <div class="note-inner">
      <header class="note-head"><span class="serial">Nº 012</span><svg class="seal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#rosette"/></svg><span class="issue">THE HALL</span></header>
      <h3>The Gavel</h3>
      <div class="verse">
        <p data-r="A">There was a young Bill from the hall</p>
        <p data-r="A">Who'd pass on each bill like a law;</p>
        <p data-r="B">He'd gavel the day,</p>
        <p data-r="B">Then he'd gavel away,</p>
        <p data-r="A" class="last">And he'd gavel it all.</p>
      </div>
      <footer class="micro">Not legal tender · aabba · this note bounces</footer>
    </div>
    <span class="note-num" aria-hidden="true">12</span>
  </article>

  <article class="note" data-id="13" tabindex="0" aria-label="Limerick 13, One Penny Left. Activate to bounce it.">
    <div class="note-inner">
      <header class="note-head"><span class="serial">Nº 013</span><svg class="seal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#rosette"/></svg><span class="issue">THE GLEN</span></header>
      <h3>One Penny Left</h3>
      <div class="verse">
        <p data-r="A">There was a young Bill from the glen</p>
        <p data-r="A">Who'd lose his whole wage, and then</p>
        <p data-r="B">He'd rummage his coat</p>
        <p data-r="B">And out would he shout:</p>
        <p data-r="A" class="last">"At least one, I've won!"</p>
      </div>
      <footer class="micro">Not legal tender · aabba · handle with a light hand</footer>
    </div>
    <span class="note-num" aria-hidden="true">13</span>
  </article>

  <article class="note" data-id="14" tabindex="0" aria-label="Limerick 14, The Corn Mill. Activate to bounce it.">
    <div class="note-inner">
      <header class="note-head"><span class="serial">Nº 014</span><svg class="seal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#rosette"/></svg><span class="issue">THE HILL</span></header>
      <h3>The Corn Mill</h3>
      <div class="verse">
        <p data-r="A">There was a young Bill from the hill</p>
        <p data-r="A">Who ran a great corn mill with a will;</p>
        <p data-r="B">It would grind out the wheat</p>
        <p data-r="B">And it'd never be beat —</p>
        <p data-r="A" class="last">Nor by any still!</p>
      </div>
      <footer class="micro">Not legal tender · aabba · bounce before folding</footer>
    </div>
    <span class="note-num" aria-hidden="true">14</span>
  </article>

  <article class="note" data-id="15" tabindex="0" aria-label="Limerick 15, Doctor's Orders. Activate to bounce it.">
    <div class="note-inner">
      <header class="note-head"><span class="serial">Nº 015</span><svg class="seal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#rosette"/></svg><span class="issue">GALWAY</span></header>
      <h3>Doctor's Orders</h3>
      <div class="verse">
        <p data-r="A">There was a young Bill from Galway</p>
        <p data-r="A">Who was doctor. "A bill!" said the lay;</p>
        <p data-r="B">"Not a bill, my friend —</p>
        <p data-r="B">What you need, in the end,</p>
        <p data-r="A" class="last">Is a prescription. Pay."</p>
      </div>
      <footer class="micro">Not legal tender · aabba · this note bounces</footer>
    </div>
    <span class="note-num" aria-hidden="true">15</span>
  </article>

  <article class="note" data-id="16" tabindex="0" aria-label="Limerick 16, The Tab. Activate to bounce it.">
    <div class="note-inner">
      <header class="note-head"><span class="serial">Nº 016</span><svg class="seal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#rosette"/></svg><span class="issue">THE BAR</span></header>
      <h3>The Tab</h3>
      <div class="verse">
        <p data-r="A">There was a young Bill at the bar</p>
        <p data-r="A">Who'd swear he'd be out by the four;</p>
        <p data-r="B">At the tab he'd grow pale —</p>
        <p data-r="B">It was huge, it was tall —</p>
        <p data-r="A" class="last">And he'd pawn out a car.</p>
      </div>
      <footer class="micro">Not legal tender · aabba · handle with a light hand</footer>
    </div>
    <span class="note-num" aria-hidden="true">16</span>
  </article>

  <article class="note" data-id="17" tabindex="0" aria-label="Limerick 17, The Last Will. Activate to bounce it.">
    <div class="note-inner">
      <header class="note-head"><span class="serial">Nº 017</span><svg class="seal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#rosette"/></svg><span class="issue">THE MILL</span></header>
      <h3>The Last Will</h3>
      <div class="verse">
        <p data-r="A">There was a young Bill from the mill</p>
        <p data-r="A">Who'd written a will with a quill:</p>
        <p data-r="B">"The barn to the dog,</p>
        <p data-r="B">The door to the hog —</p>
        <p data-r="A" class="last">And the rest, to the mill."</p>
      </div>
      <footer class="micro">Not legal tender · aabba · bounce before folding</footer>
    </div>
    <span class="note-num" aria-hidden="true">17</span>
  </article>

  <article class="note" data-id="18" tabindex="0" aria-label="Limerick 18, The Trumpet Note. Activate to bounce it.">
    <div class="note-inner">
      <header class="note-head"><span class="serial">Nº 018</span><svg class="seal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#rosette"/></svg><span class="issue">THE GLEN</span></header>
      <h3>The Trumpet Note</h3>
      <div class="verse">
        <p data-r="A">There was a young Bill from the glen</p>
        <p data-r="A">Who'd play out a trumpet, and then</p>
        <p data-r="B">He'd blast out a note</p>
        <p data-r="B">That would startle the goat —</p>
        <p data-r="A" class="last">And the dog left the den.</p>
      </div>
      <footer class="micro">Not legal tender · aabba · this note bounces</footer>
    </div>
    <span class="note-num" aria-hidden="true">18</span>
  </article>

  <article class="note" data-id="19" tabindex="0" aria-label="Limerick 19, Itemizing the Tea. Activate to bounce it.">
    <div class="note-inner">
      <header class="note-head"><span class="serial">Nº 019</span><svg class="seal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#rosette"/></svg><span class="issue">THE FAIR</span></header>
      <h3>Itemizing the Tea</h3>
      <div class="verse">
        <p data-r="A">There was a young Bill from the fair</p>
        <p data-r="A">Who'd bill out his friends for the air,</p>
        <p data-r="B">The chair, and the floor,</p>
        <p data-r="B">And the tea, and more —</p>
        <p data-r="A" class="last">And his friends were not there.</p>
      </div>
      <footer class="micro">Not legal tender · aabba · handle with a light hand</footer>
    </div>
    <span class="note-num" aria-hidden="true">19</span>
  </article>

  <article class="note" data-id="20" tabindex="0" aria-label="Limerick 20, The Bills of Ballybail. Activate to bounce it.">
    <div class="note-inner">
      <header class="note-head"><span class="serial">Nº 020</span><svg class="seal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#rosette"/></svg><span class="issue">BALLYBAIL</span></header>
      <h3>The Bills of Ballybail</h3>
      <div class="verse">
        <p data-r="A">The Bills of Ballybail</p>
        <p data-r="A">Got bailed out by every jail;</p>
        <p data-r="B">So often — it's said —</p>
        <p data-r="B">That the constable's head</p>
        <p data-r="A" class="last">Ached from writing the bail.</p>
      </div>
      <footer class="micro">Not legal tender · aabba · bounce before folding</footer>
    </div>
    <span class="note-num" aria-hidden="true">20</span>
  </article>

  <article class="note" data-id="21" tabindex="0" aria-label="Limerick 21, Past Due. Activate to bounce it.">
    <div class="note-inner">
      <header class="note-head"><span class="serial">Nº 021</span><svg class="seal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#rosette"/></svg><span class="issue">THE DEN</span></header>
      <h3>Past Due</h3>
      <div class="verse">
        <p data-r="A">There was a young Bill from the den</p>
        <p data-r="A">Who'd found a surprise by the hen;</p>
        <p data-r="B">"Dear Bill — your account</p>
        <p data-r="B">Ought to be paid out,</p>
        <p data-r="A" class="last">Or we'll repossess the pen."</p>
      </div>
      <footer class="micro">Not legal tender · aabba · this note bounces</footer>
    </div>
    <span class="note-num" aria-hidden="true">21</span>
  </article>

  <article class="note" data-id="22" tabindex="0" aria-label="Limerick 22, The Gilded Bill. Activate to bounce it.">
    <div class="note-inner">
      <header class="note-head"><span class="serial">Nº 022</span><svg class="seal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#rosette"/></svg><span class="issue">THE BAY</span></header>
      <h3>The Gilded Bill</h3>
      <div class="verse">
        <p data-r="A">There was a young Bill from the bay</p>
        <p data-r="A">Who'd hauled up a fish on the day;</p>
        <p data-r="B">Its bill, gilded and bright,</p>
        <p data-r="B">Had been polished — one might</p>
        <p data-r="A" class="last">Mistake it for a tray.</p>
      </div>
      <footer class="micro">Not legal tender · aabba · handle with a light hand</footer>
    </div>
    <span class="note-num" aria-hidden="true">22</span>
  </article>

  <article class="note" data-id="23" tabindex="0" aria-label="Limerick 23, The Paper Den. Activate to bounce it.">
    <div class="note-inner">
      <header class="note-head"><span class="serial">Nº 023</span><svg class="seal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#rosette"/></svg><span class="issue">THE GLEN</span></header>
      <h3>The Paper Den</h3>
      <div class="verse">
        <p data-r="A">There was a young Bill from the glen</p>
        <p data-r="A">Who'd take his wage in notes, then</p>
        <p data-r="B">Fold each fiver square</p>
        <p data-r="B">And paste them everywhere —</p>
        <p data-r="A" class="last">Wall, floor, and the den.</p>
      </div>
      <footer class="micro">Not legal tender · aabba · bounce before folding</footer>
    </div>
    <span class="note-num" aria-hidden="true">23</span>
  </article>

  <article class="note" data-id="24" tabindex="0" aria-label="Limerick 24, The Hooray. Activate to bounce it.">
    <div class="note-inner">
      <header class="note-head"><span class="serial">Nº 024</span><svg class="seal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#rosette"/></svg><span class="issue">THE QUAY</span></header>
      <h3>The Hooray</h3>
      <div class="verse">
        <p data-r="A">There was a young Bill from the quay</p>
        <p data-r="A">Who'd made a great fortune, hooray —</p>
        <p data-r="B">His very first treat:</p>
        <p data-r="B">He'd pay out the street</p>
        <p data-r="A" class="last">And tip out the day.</p>
      </div>
      <footer class="micro">Not legal tender · aabba · this note bounces</footer>
    </div>
    <span class="note-num" aria-hidden="true">24</span>
  </article>

  <article class="note" data-id="25" tabindex="0" aria-label="Limerick 25, Still. Activate to bounce it.">
    <div class="note-inner">
      <header class="note-head"><span class="serial">Nº 025</span><svg class="seal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#rosette"/></svg><span class="issue">THE HALL</span></header>
      <h3>Still</h3>
      <div class="verse">
        <p data-r="A">There was a young Bill from the hall</p>
        <p data-r="A">Who'd read out these twenty-five, and all</p>
        <p data-r="B">The rhymes, and the bills,</p>
        <p data-r="B">And he'd shrug at the wills,</p>
        <p data-r="A" class="last">And sit down, and be still.</p>
      </div>
      <footer class="micro">Not legal tender · aabba · end of series — thank you</footer>
    </div>
    <span class="note-num" aria-hidden="true">25</span>
  </article>

<script>
(function(){
  var grid   = document.getElementById('grid');
  var notes  = Array.prototype.slice.call(grid.querySelectorAll('.note'));
  var RM     = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  var countEl= document.getElementById('bounceCount');
  var bonded = document.getElementById('bonded');
  var bounced= {};

  var tilt  = function(){ return (Math.random()*4.6-2.3).toFixed(2)+'deg'; };
  notes.forEach(function(n){
    n.style.setProperty('--tilt', tilt());
    n.style.setProperty('--lift', (Math.floor(Math.random()*13)-6)+'px');
  });

  /* ---- bounce counter ---- */
  function update(){
    var k = 0; for(var id in bounced) k++;
    countEl.textContent = 'bounced '+k+'/25';

  const notes=[...grid.children];
  const first=notes.map(n=>n.getBoundingClientRect());
  // Fisher-Yates
  for(let i=notes.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[grid.children[i],grid.children[j]]=[grid.children[j],grid.children[i]];}

      n.style.transform='';

    }));

}

  background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='150' height='150'><g fill='none' stroke='%23BFE8CF' stroke-opacity='0.055' stroke-width='1'><ellipse cx='75' cy='75' rx='60' ry='24'/><ellipse cx='75' cy='75' rx='60' ry='24' transform='rotate(45 75 75)'/><ellipse cx='75' cy='75' rx='60' ry='24' transform='rotate(90 75 75)'/><ellipse cx='75' cy='75' rx='60' ry='24' transform='rotate(135 75 75)'/><ellipse cx='75' cy='75' rx='34' ry='14' transform='rotate(22 75 75)'/><ellipse cx='75' cy='75' rx='34' ry='14' transform='rotate(112 75 75)'/></g></svg>");
  background-size:150px 150px;
}
/* paper grain */
body::after{
  content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:70;pointer-events:none;opacity:.05;mix-blend-mode:overlay;
  background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='180' height='180'><filter id='n'><feTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='.8' numOctaves='2' stitchTiles='stitch'/></filter><rect width='180' height='180' filter='url(%23n)'/></svg>");
}
::selection{background:var(--red);color:var(--paper)}

/* ---- banknote frame ---- */
.frame{position:fixed;inset:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);z-index:60;pointer-events:none}
.frame::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:7px;border:1px dashed rgba(191,232,207,.1)}
.corner{position:absolute;width:14px;height:14px;color:rgba(191,232,207,.4)}
.c-tl{top:-8px;left:-8px}.c-tr{top:-8px;right:-8px}.c-bl{bottom:-8px;left:-8px}.c-br{bottom:-8px;right:-8px}

/* ---- drifting watermarks ---- */
.watermark{position:fixed;z-index:0;font-family:var(--f-disp);font-style:italic;font-weight:900;
  color:rgba(191,232,207,.045);pointer-events:none;user-select:none;line-height:.8;letter-spacing:-.03em;will-change:transform}
.wm-a{font-size:30vw;left:-5vw;top:14vh}
.wm-b{font-size:22vw;right:-3vw;bottom:-8vh}

/* ---- masthead ---- */
.masthead{position:relative;z-index:1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.25fr .75fr;gap:clamp(26px,4vw,56px);
  align-items:end;padding-bottom:clamp(28px,4vw,46px)}
.kicker{font:500 10.5px/1.7 var(--f-mono);letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mint-dim);
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.kicker::before{content:"";width:46px;height:1px;background:var(--red);flex:none}
.title{font-family:var(--f-disp);font-weight:900;font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(4.4rem,11vw,8.6rem);
  line-height:.88;color:var(--paper);letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:20px 0 14px;text-shadow:4px 4px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.28)}
.title .dot{color:var(--red)}
.title sup{font:600 clamp(.95rem,1.8vw,1.3rem)/1 var(--f-mono);letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--red);
  margin-left:12px;vertical-align:super;text-shadow:none}
.dek{font-size:clamp(1.05rem,1.6vw,1.28rem);line-height:1.55;max-width:54ch;color:rgba(230,245,235,.85);font-style:italic}
.dek em{color:var(--paper);font-weight:600}
.scheme{margin-top:22px;font:500 10px/1.8 var(--f-mono);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mint-dim);flex-wrap:wrap}
.scheme b{font-weight:600}
.scheme .a{color:var(--red)}.scheme .b{color:#7ED9A8}

/* stamp + seal cluster */
.mast-right{display:flex;gap:26px;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:flex-end}
.stamp{background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);padding:16px 18px 13px;width:152px;text-align:center;position:relative;
  border:1px solid var(--ink);box-shadow:7px 9px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.3);transform:rotate(-5deg);
  transition:transform .55s var(--bounce)}
.stamp::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:5px;border:1px dashed var(--red);pointer-events:none}
.stamp:hover{transform:rotate(-1deg) translateY(-5px)}
.stamp-top{display:block;font:500 8.5px/1.5 var(--f-mono);letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.stamp-val{display:block;font-family:var(--f-disp);font-weight:900;font-style:italic;font-size:58px;line-height:1.05;color:var(--red)}
.stamp-val small{font-size:20px;margin-left:2px}
.stamp-bot{display:block;font:500 8px/1.5 var(--f-mono);letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:8px}
.seal-wrap{position:relative;width:96px;height:96px;color:var(--mint);transform:rotate(8deg)}
.seal-big{width:100%;height:100%;opacity:.92;transition:transform 1.5s cubic-bezier(.3,.1,.2,1)}
.seal-wrap:hover .seal-big{transform:rotate(360deg)}
.seal-num{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:var(--f-disp);font-style:italic;
  font-weight:900;font-size:22px;color:var(--paper);pointer-events:none}

/* ---- ticker ---- */
.ticker{position:relative;z-index:1;border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:9px 0;overflow:hidden}
.ticker-track{display:flex;width:max-content;animation:tick 38s linear infinite}
.ticker-track span{font:500 10.5px/1 var(--f-mono);letter-spacing:.18em;color:var(--mint-dim);white-space:nowrap;padding-right:3rem}
.ticker:hover .ticker-track{animation-play-state:paused}
@keyframes tick{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}

/* ---- sticky toolbar ---- */
.bar{position:sticky;top:14px;z-index:50;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;
  padding:13px 16px;margin:26px 0 clamp(30px,4vw,46px);
  background:rgba(10,32,22,.93);border:1px solid var(--line);backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
.bar-left{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:baseline;flex-wrap:wrap;font:500 10px/1.6 var(--f-mono);letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mint-dim)}
.bar-series{color:var(--mint)}
.bar-count{color:var(--red);font-weight:600}
.bonded{margin-left:auto;border:2px solid var(--red);color:var(--red);padding:6px 10px;font:600 10px/1 var(--f-mono);
  letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;transform:rotate(-4deg);opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.bonded.show{opacity:1;animation:stampIn .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.5) both}
@keyframes stampIn{0%{opacity:0;transform:rotate(-16deg) scale(2.2)}100%{opacity:1;transform:rotate(-4deg) scale(1)}}
.bar-actions{display:flex;gap:10px}
.btn{font:600 11px/1 var(--f-mono);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:11px 15px;cursor:pointer;
  border:1px solid transparent;transition:transform .2s var(--bounce),box-shadow .2s var(--bounce),background .2s}
.btn.solid{background:var(--red);color:var(--paper);border-color:#8E2A14;box-shadow:3px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.btn.solid:hover{transform:translate(-1px,-1px);box-shadow:5px 5px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.btn.solid:active{transform:translate(2px,2px);box-shadow:0 0 0 rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--mint);border-color:rgba(191,232,207,.4)}
.btn.ghost:hover{background:rgba(191,232,207,.09);transform:translate(-1px,-1px)}
.btn:focus-visible{outline:2px dashed var(--red);outline-offset:3px}

/* ---- the notes ---- */
.grid{position:relative;z-index:1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(295px,1fr));gap:clamp(20px,2.4vw,28px)}
.note{position:relative;opacity:0;cursor:pointer;outline:none;
  transform:rotate(var(--tilt,0deg)) translateY(var(--lift,0px))}
.js .note{opacity:0}
.js .note.in{opacity:1;animation:settle .65s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.3,1.15) backwards;animation-delay:var(--d,0ms);
  transition:transform .5s var(--bounce)}
@keyframes settle{from{opacity:0;transform:rotate(calc(var(--tilt,0deg)*2.6)) translateY(40px) scale(.97)}}
.js .note.in:hover,.js .note.in:focus-visible{transform:rotate(0deg) translateY(-10px)}
.note:focus-visible .note-inner{outline:2px dashed var(--red);outline-offset:5px}
.note-inner{position:relative;background:
  repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(23,56,43,.03) 0 1px, transparent 1px 28px),
  radial-gradient(130px 95px at 100% 0, rgba(216,73,43,.08), transparent 70%),
  var(--paper);
  color:var(--ink);padding:17px 19px 14px;box-shadow:0 12px 26px -16px rgba(0,0,0,.6);transition:box-shadow .5s}
.note-inner::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:7px;border:1px dashed rgba(23,56,43,.3);pointer-events:none}
.note.in:hover .note-inner{box-shadow:0 30px 48px -18px rgba(0,0,0,.65)}
.note-inner.hop{animation:hop .78s cubic-bezier(.3,.1,.4,1)}
@keyframes hop{
  0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}
  12%{transform:translateY(-10px)} 26%{transform:translateY(0)}
  40%{transform:translateY(-9px)}  54%{transform:translateY(0)}
  68%{transform:translateY(-18px)} 82%{transform:translateY(0)}
  90%{transform:translateY(-5px)}
}
.note-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:2px 0 13px}
.serial{color:var(--red);font:600 10px/1 var(--f-mono);letter-spacing:.14em}
.issue{margin-left:auto;font:500 9px/1 var(--f-mono);letter-spacing:.24em;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.note .seal{width:17px;height:17px;flex:none;color:rgba(23,56,43,.45);transition:transform .7s cubic-bezier(.3,.1,.2,1)}
.note.in:hover .seal{transform:rotate(144deg)}
.note h3{font-family:var(--f-disp);font-weight:700;font-size:1.38rem;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin-bottom:10px}
.verse p{font-size:1.05rem;line-height:1.5;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:baseline;margin:2px 0}
.verse p::before{content:attr(data-r);font:600 8.5px/1 var(--f-mono);flex:0 0 8px;margin-top:4px}
.verse p[data-r="A"]::before{color:var(--red)}
.verse p[data-r="B"]::before{color:#2E7C55}
.verse p.last{font-style:italic;font-weight:600;font-size:1.12rem;margin-top:7px}
.micro{margin-top:15px;padding-top:8px;border-top:1px solid rgba(23,56,43,.15);
  font:500 7.5px/1.6 var(--f-mono);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.note-num{position:absolute;right:12px;bottom:-16px;font-family:var(--f-disp);font-style:italic;font-weight:900;
  font-size:4.3rem;color:rgba(23,56,43,.09);pointer-events:none;user-select:none}

/* ---- colophon ---- */
.colophon{position:relative;z-index:1;margin:clamp(52px,6vw,84px) 0 34px;padding-top:24px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:36px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.fin{font-family:var(--f-disp);font-style:italic;font-weight:900;font-size:2.7rem;color:var(--paper);line-height:1}
.fin .dot{color:var(--red)}
.colo-l p:last-child{margin-top:12px;font-style:italic;color:rgba(230,245,235,.75)}
.colo-r{font:500 10px/2.1 var(--f-mono);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mint-dim);text-align:right}
.colo-r b{color:var(--mint);font-weight:600}

@media (max-width:840px){
  .masthead{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .mast-right{justify-content:flex-start}
  .colo-r{text-align:left}
  .bar-hint{display:none}
  .wm-a{font-size:64vw}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
  html{scroll-behavior:auto}
  .ticker-track,.note,.note-inner,.stamp,.seal-big,.btn,.bonded{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}
  .note{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important}
}
</style>
</head>

<main>
<section class="grid" id="grid" aria-label="The twenty-five limericks">

  <article class="note" data-id="1" tabindex="0" aria-label="Limerick 1, The Kildare Ledger. Activate to bounce it.">
    <div class="note-inner">
      <header class="note-head"><span class="serial">Nº 001</span><svg class="seal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#rosette"/></svg><span class="issue">KILDARE</span></header>
      <h3>The Kildare Ledger</h3>
      <div class="verse">
        <p data-r="A">There was a young Bill from Kildare</p>
        <p data-r="A">Who kept every receipt that was there —</p>
        <p data-r="B">For socks, for his lunch,</p>
        <p data-r="B">For the post, and such:</p>
        <p data-r="A" class="last">Five thousand bills in a chair.</p>
      </div>
      <footer class="micro">Not legal tender · aabba · handle with a light hand</footer>
    </div>
    <span class="note-num" aria-hidden="true">01</span>
  </article>

  <article class="note" data-id="2" tabindex="0" aria-label="Limerick 2, The Quay Economist. Activate to bounce it.">
    <div class="note-inner">
      <header class="note-head"><span class="serial">Nº 002</span><svg class="seal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#rosette"/></svg><span class="issue">THE QUAY</span></header>
      <h3>The Quay Economist</h3>
      <div class="verse">
        <p data-r="A">An economist, Bill, from the quay</p>
        <p data-r="A">Graphed out the true price of the day;</p>
        <p data-r="B">He mislaid the whole chart,</p>
        <p data-r="B">And had to restart:</p>
        <p data-r="A" class="last">He was charting the pay.</p>
      </div>
      <footer class="micro">Not legal tender · aabba · bounce before folding</footer>
    </div>
    <span class="note-num" aria-hidden="true">02</span>
  </article>

  <article class="note" data-id="3" tabindex="0" aria-label="Limerick 3, A Note From Jurgen. Activate to bounce it.">
    <div class="note-inner">
      <header class="note-head"><span class="serial">Nº 003</span><svg class="seal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#rosette"/></svg><span class="issue">THE FIRM</span></header>
      <h3>A Note From Jurgen</h3>
      <div class="verse">
        <p data-r="A">The economist, Jurgen, one day</p>
        <p data-r="A">Sent a bill to the firm, and they'd pay;</p>
        <p data-r="B">Bill, with a grin,</p>
        <p data-r="B">Said, "My wage's coming in!" —</p>
        <p data-r="A" class="last">But it never was paid.</p>
      </div>
      <footer class="micro">Not legal tender · aabba · this note bounces</footer>
    </div>
    <span class="note-num" aria-hidden="true">03</span>
  </article>

  <article class="note" data-id="4" tabindex="0" aria-label="Limerick 4, The Bally Billigator. Activate to bounce it.">
    <div class="note-inner">
      <header class="note-head"><span class="serial">Nº 004</span><svg class="seal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#rosette"/></svg><span class="issue">BALLY</span></header>
      <h3>The Bally Billigator</h3>
      <div class="verse">
        <p data-r="A">There was a young Bill from Bally</p>
        <p data-r="A">Who'd tamed a billigator daily —</p>
        <p data-r="B">The neighbors were scared;</p>
        <p data-r="B">He said, "Not a word:</p>
        <p data-r="A" class="last">He's a good boy — he barks gaily."</p>
      </div>
      <footer class="micro">Not legal tender · aabba · handle with a light hand</footer>
    </div>
    <span class="note-num" aria-hidden="true">04</span>
  </article>

  <article class="note" data-id="5" tabindex="0" aria-label="Limerick 5, Triple Fare. Activate to bounce it.">
    <div class="note-inner">
      <header class="note-head"><span class="serial">Nº 005</span><svg class="seal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#rosette"/></svg><span class="issue">THE FAIR</span></header>
      <h3>Triple Fare</h3>
      <div class="verse">
        <p data-r="A">There was a young Bill from the fair</p>
        <p data-r="A">Whose accountant sent triple the fare;</p>
        <p data-r="B">"Double! Triple!" cried Bill —</p>
        <p data-r="B">The letter said, "Still,</p>
        <p data-r="A" class="last">You must pay it, by the square."</p>
      </div>
      <footer class="micro">Not legal tender · aabba · bounce before folding</footer>
    </div>
    <span class="note-num" aria-hidden="true">05</span>
  </article>

  <article class="note" data-id="6" tabindex="0" aria-label="Limerick 6, A Fine Call. Activate to bounce it.">
    <div class="note-inner">
      <header class="note-head"><span class="serial">Nº 006</span><svg class="seal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#rosette"/></svg><span class="issue">THE HALL</span></header>
      <h3>A Fine Call</h3>
      <div class="verse">
        <p data-r="A">There was a young Bill from the hall</p>
        <p data-r="A">Who could pot the last brown of them all;</p>
        <p data-r="B">The cue, on its way,</p>
        <p data-r="B">Knocked a teacup astray</p>
        <p data-r="A" class="last">Into Bill — a fine call.</p>
      </div>
      <footer class="micro">Not legal tender · aabba · this note bounces</footer>
    </div>
    <span class="note-num" aria-hidden="true">06</span>
  </article>

  <article class="note" data-id="7" tabindex="0" aria-label="Limerick 7, The Mill Bell. Activate to bounce it.">
    <div class="note-inner">
      <header class="note-head"><span class="serial">Nº 007</span><svg class="seal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#rosette"/></svg><span class="issue">THE MILL</span></header>
      <h3>The Mill Bell</h3>
      <div class="verse">
        <p data-r="A">There was a young Bill from the mill</p>
        <p data-r="A">Who rang the bell with great skill;</p>
        <p data-r="B">He rang one, he rang two,</p>
        <p data-r="B">He rang three — and he'd do</p>
        <p data-r="A" class="last">Another, but then it was still.</p>
      </div>
      <footer class="micro">Not legal tender · aabba · handle with a light hand</footer>
    </div>
    <span class="note-num" aria-hidden="true">07</span>
  </article>

  <article class="note" data-id="8" tabindex="0" aria-label="Limerick 8, Supper at the Den. Activate to bounce it.">
    <div class="note-inner">
      <header class="note-head"><span class="serial">Nº 008</span><svg class="seal" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#rosette"/></svg><span class="issue">THE DEN</span></header>
      <h3>Supper at the Den</h3>
      <div class="verse">
        <p data-r="A">There was a young Bill from the den</p>
        <p data-r="A">Whose wife, Jill, named their cat, Ben;</p>
        <p data-r="B">The two would brawl</p>
        <p data-r="B">At the first supper call —</p>
        <p data-r="A" class="last">And it always went to the hen.</p>
      </div>

const tilted=()=> (Math.random()*4.6-2.3).toFixed(2)+'deg';
notes.forEach((n,i)=>{ n.style.setProperty('--tilt',tilted()); n.style.setProperty('--lift',(Math.floor(Math.random()*13)-6)+'px'); });

const bounced=new Set();
function updateCount(){countEl.textContent=`bounced ${bounced.size}/25`; if(bounced.size===25){bondedEl.classList.add('show');}}
function hop(n){bounced.add(n.dataset.id); if(!RM){const inner=n.querySelector('.note-inner'); inner.classList.remove('hop'); void inner.offsetWidth; inner.classList.add('hop');} updateCount();}
notes.forEach(n=>{n.addEventListener('click',()=>hop(n)); n.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();hop(n);}});});

else{

 const io=new IntersectionObserver(es=>{
  const ent=es.filter(e=>e.isIntersecting);
  ent.forEach((e,j)=>{e.target.style.setProperty('--d',(j*90)+'ms'); e.target.classList.add('in'); io.unobserve(e.target);});
 }, {threshold:.15, rootMargin:'0px 0px -5% 0px'});
 notes.forEach(n=>io.observe(n));

Shuffle:
function shuffle(){
 const kids=[...grid.children];
 const first=new Map(kids.map(k=>[k,k.getBoundingClientRect()]));
 for(let i=kids.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1)); grid.appendChild(kids[j]); [kids[i],kids[j]]=[kids[j],kids[i]];}
 kids.forEach(k=>{
  const f=first.get(k), l=k.getBoundingClientRect();
  const dx=f.left-l.left, dy=f.top-l.top;
  const t=tilted();
  if(RM){k.style.setProperty('--tilt',t);return;}
  k.style.transition='none';
  k.style.transform=`translate(${dx}px,${dy}px) rotate(var(--tilt))`;
  void k.offsetWidth;
  k.style.transition='transform .7s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.28,1.05)';
  k.style.transform=`rotate(${t})`;
  k.style.setProperty('--tilt',t);
 });
 setTimeout(()=>kids.forEach(k=>{k.style.transition='';k.style.transform='';}),850);
}

06:

11:

12:

22:
